purpose: Provide one server-trusted positive feature-release and tenant-enrollment prerequisite for the R7 HRIS slices before any PAGE, navigation, workspace or owner call can become visible or executable.

rejectedReuse.reason: Its absent-row default is ENABLED and its DISABLED or INHERIT states only suppress existing authority. Reusing it as a positive activation source would make missing rows an enablement bypass.
rejectedReuse.preservedRole: After positive feature activation and enrollment, it remains an additional capability restriction and may only narrow authority.

governedFeatures.scopeInvariant: The PAGE keeps CONFIG_SCOPE. Both exception DATA decisions require their own TARGET_POPULATION authority; PAGE admission must never be reused as the DATA population scope.
governedFeatures.positiveMountRequirement: The frontend must obtain separate exact direct DATA decisions and an independent exception package-scope selection before mounting any exception data source or hook.

excludedSharedRoute.reason: The shared route can serve Timecard and close receipts, so binding it only to HRIS_TIME_CLOSE_HANDOFF would incorrectly suppress Timecard audit access. Leaving it ungated is also insufficient because the registry probes every provider and TIM requires zero close-provider and repository calls while the close feature is absent, false or unenrolled.
p0BeforeTimActivation: either introduce a separately governed close-receipt route in an independently authorized v51 successor
or preserve an owner-local activation projection and select the sealed origin feature before any close provider ownership or repository probe

v259Contract.routeUniqueness: route_contract_key is globally unique across feature bindings
immutability: catalog, policy and route rows reject UPDATE and DELETE through database triggers; changes require versioned append-only successors
at most one open or ACTIVE workflow winner exists per global feature and per tenant-feature through partial unique indexes
feature key, product key, APP.HCM, minimum bundle version, route kind and Product Surface subject or surface must remain mutually consistent
all 16 seeded route bindings must match the immutable v50 route kind, product and surface tuple

workflow.separationOfDuties: requester, reviewer and activator are three distinct actors
workflow.history: append-only immutable receipt and event history

v259Contract.tenantAppPrerequisite: The tenant hcm app installation must be ENABLED before a tenant enrollment can become ACTIVE.

runtimeDecisionOrder: validate exact registered route and subject
evaluate existing app entitlement, capability or responsibility, scope, SoD and tenant capability suppression
only if the existing outcome would be ALLOWED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED, resolve the feature binding and positive gate
return TENANT_APP_ADOPTION_REQUIRED before reading or disclosing global activation or tenant enrollment when the APP.HCM installation is absent or disabled
return FEATURE_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED when no active global release exists
return TENANT_FEATURE_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED when the tenant is not actively enrolled
preserve the prior ALLOWED or STEP_UP_REQUIRED outcome only when all positive prerequisites are active
return AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_UNAVAILABLE on schema, reader, duplicate-binding, revision or evidence failure
privacyInvariant: A user who fails the existing authorization must receive the existing app, route, scope or SoD denial and must not learn feature activation or enrollment state.
providerSupportInvariant: Support or provider access never bypasses the positive activation and tenant-enrollment gate.

digestInputs: tenant app installation state and version
wireRequirements: Auth authority result, Gateway authority client, SourceRevisions, aggregation support and service, frontend auth API and parser all require a nonblank tenantControl revision
the composite decision and product-evaluation revision include tenantControl as a separate source
an UNGATED route receives a stable catalog plus UNGATED revision rather than an empty or omitted value
missing or malformed tenantControl evidence fails closed as AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_UNAVAILABLE
revisionContract.forbidden: Do not append a suffix to existing policyRevision or authRevision values because current consumers use their exact format and equality.

gatewayEnforcement.problem: The current 000/100 rollout may bypass Auth PRODUCT evaluation and call an owner directly.
gatewayEnforcement.required: The exact closed set of all 16 governed route keys always performs Auth direct evaluation independent of rollout percentage.
gatewayEnforcement.driftControl: A targeted parity test must compare the V259 route seed set with the Gateway closed set.
gatewayEnforcement.ownerBypassClosure: For all governed routes, an owner service must validate exact trusted decision evidence even when a rollout second bit is zero. People HcmProductSurfacePepFilter may not bypass exact PEP for HRM-005 at 000/100; Payroll and Platform existing exact-evidence behavior must be preserved.

denyBehavior.active: forward only with trusted decision evidence

frontendAdmission.source: exact direct Product Surface PAGE decision only
frontendAdmission.navigation: Product Surface allowed paths intersect tenant navigation policy; navigation policy can only narrow and never activate.
frontendAdmission.directLink: The same PAGE decision guards the direct route and first-allowed-page selection.
frontendAdmission.workspace: The active subtree and its hooks or data source mount only after exact PAGE admission and a typed module adapter are both present.
frontendAdmission.sysDataAdmission: SYS obtains exact exception list and detail DATA decisions plus an independent TARGET_POPULATION package-scope selection; PAGE CONFIG_SCOPE never enters the DATA adapter.
frontendAdmission.reasonUx: The frontend preserves FEATURE_ACTIVATION_REQUIRED, TENANT_FEATURE_ENROLLMENT_REQUIRED, TENANT_APP_ADOPTION_REQUIRED and AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION_UNAVAILABLE distinctly. Feature-control reasons must not link to the unrelated /account/security#privileged-access page; an authorized tenant feature-management destination or a safe return action is required.
forbidden: tenant ID allowlists in frontend source or configuration
a browser featureActivations snapshot as a second authority
using PAGE CONFIG_SCOPE as SYS exception DATA TARGET_POPULATION

ownerDefense.required: Owner PEP validates exact trusted route, context, scope, decision revision, revalidateAt, access mode, purpose and population; missing trusted evidence fails closed.
ownerDefense.localEnrollmentRemovalOrder: Remove HRM, PAY and SYS owner-local tenant lists only after V259 Auth evaluation, Gateway always-evaluate enforcement and owner exact-evidence behavior are integrated and proven. Do not remove the TIM shared-receipt local activation projection before its separate zero-call P0 gate closes.
ownerDefense.backgroundWorkers: Non-HTTP workers consume an activation event/outbox read projection and skip work when absent, stale or unavailable; local tenant strings are forbidden.

activationBlockers.blocks: HRIS_TIME_CLOSE_HANDOFF global activation or tenant enrollment
activationBlockers.doesNotBlock: default-OFF catalog, module source, central adapter design or targeted tests

activationBlockers.blocks: HRIS_OPERATIONS_EXCEPTION_CENTER global activation, tenant enrollment or positive workspace mount
activationBlockers.doesNotBlock: default-OFF activation substrate and exact DATA adapter implementation
